notes.title: Dragoon Ascension Update

2) New dungeon with more enemies added

3) Balancing for Glacier Pass area monsters

notes.title: Dragoon Ascension Update
notes.content:
1) A new skill for the dragoon has been added (Dynamo). Level 50 special attack.

2) Guard ring token cost is now 9 from 13 at the arena exchange.

3) Lykos are now slightly faster with a bit more defense and m.defense.

4) When stampede is used, it will make the skill sound once instead of for each enemy.

5) Updated some icons for display text that weren't correct.
